errors.text_span: 随后在3至6之间维持在77.6%至77.8%之间
errors.evidence: The description over-generalizes the trend for F1 between x=3 and x=6. The values actually fluctuate from about 77.4% to a peak of 77.9% at x=5. The stated range of 77.6% to 77.8% is incorrect and misses the peak.
The value for F1 at captured_distance=7 is visibly above 76.5%, approximately 76.6%. The stated value of 76.4% is an inaccurate reading from the chart.

The description incorrectly states that the Acc value is maintained at 76.4% between x=3 and x=4. The chart shows a slight dip at x=3 (to ~76.3%) and a rise at x=4 (to ~76.5%); it does not remain constant.

The peak value for Acc at captured_distance=5 is visibly above the 77% line, at approximately 77.2%. Stating the value is about 77.0% is inaccurate as the data point is clearly higher than the tick mark.
